# Code Anchors: Pointing Install

- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the install verb's pointing branch, which resolves the checkout's authored tree through the shared derivation rather than appending a directory name, and the read-out that names the content and the checkout.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/vendor-components.ts` — the derivation the pointing branch calls: the authored tree of an arbitrary checkout, from the one definition of the authored root's name.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/install-location.ts` — inspects what the location holds and reports the checkout when the content is pointers.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/install-verb.spec.ts` — the pointing mode end to end: pointers placed rather than copies, the reported location and checkout, and the settings file left untouched.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/uninstall-verb.spec.ts` — removal unlinking pointers as entries without reaching the checkout behind them.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/version-verb.spec.ts` — the read-out reporting each content, including the checkout a pointing install resolves into.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/environment-guard.ts` — the duplicate diagnostic's resolved-real-path comparison, which is what keeps this arrangement from reading as two sets.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — the maintainer's loop: running the install verb from source with the checkout flag, and confirming the content through the read-out.
